'''Bat'theria''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]], selling her wares at the Lytle Research outpost in the bombed [[City/Legends|city]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Behind the scenes==
Bat'theria first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a junk dealer selling medical equipment on Taris. She also sold a import code, which could be used to open a import crate from Tatooine.
